spans.s: (I)--was the Asura who entered heaven, snatched away the nectar vessel from Dhanvantari: मोहिनी helped the gods in the scuffle that ensued and Malaka fled to पातालम्. Br.
(I)--one of the ten wives of Atri. Br.
(II)--a daughter of भद्राश्व and घृताची. वा. ७०. ६८.
--a Vindhyan tribe; an eastern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ५३ and ६३.
--a R. sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ६३.
(I)--a son of ऋषभ and Jayanti. भा.

--a प्रदेश of जम्बुद्वीप of the म्लेच्- छस्; here is महामलय hill called second Mandaram as also Agastya's आश्रम and लन्का. वा. ४८. १४, २०-30.

--the पाण्ड्य who married the daughter of the Vidarbha King राजसिम्ह and became the father of a daughter and seven sons; a राजऋषि; divided his kingdom among his sons and with his mind set on कृष्ण retired to कुलाचल followed by his queen; after a period of strenuous तपस् he died and the queen wailed. भा. IV. २८. २९-30, ३३-34, ३६-50.

--sacred to Goddess रम्भा;
1: M. १३. २९.
rich with तमाल trees.
2: Ib. ११४. १७, ३०; १६३. ७१.
[page२-645+ २५]
--a son of Trasu, a ब्रह्मवादिन्. वा. ९९. १३२.
(I)--Candraketu, a son of लक्ष्मण styled thus or his country? वा. ८८. १८८.
(II)--the Lord of राजगृह, vanquished by कृष्ण. Br. III. ७३. १००.
--a tribe and an eastern kingdom. Br. II. १६. ५५; M. १६३. ६७.
--wrestling matches in ancient मथुरा in which all the people from the peasant to the king took part; described. भा. X. ३६. २४; ४२. ३२-38; ४
--a son of Dyutiman after whom came the kingdom of Mallagam. Vi.

--(also मालवी) the queen of अश्वपति and mother of सावित्री, the पतिव्रत;
1: M. २०८. १०.
her sons are called the मालवस् of pure क्षत्रिय stock.
2: Ib. २१३. १६.
(II)--(च्) द्विजस् of; became व्रात्यस् after the days of पुरञ्जय. भा.
--Kubera's wedding present to कामेश्वर. Br. IV. १५. २२.
--the flower seller who offered कृष्ण and राम flowers liked by them and was blessed with wealth and long life to him, to his generations of his successors. Vi. V. १९. १७-28. [page२-699+ २७]

--the father of कैकसी and father-in-law of Visravas; a follower of वृत्र in his battle with Indra; a राक्षस in the fifth talam; slain by Hari in the देवासुर war. भा. VI. १०. २१; VIII. १०. ५७; Br. II. २०. ३७;
(I)--a शक्ति; a mind-born mother. Br. IV. ३६. ७६, ९६; M. १७९. 9.
(II)--the ancient name of the city of चम्पा; also known as चम्पावती. M. ४८. ९७; वा. ९९. १०५.

(I)--Mt. a mountain range to the east of Meru, south of नील, north of निषाध and west of इलाव्रत and a boundary limit of केतुमाला, a thousand yojanas in extent; the stream चक्षुस् descends from its summits;

(II)--a son of राक्षस, Prahati; slain by Hari in the देवासुर war; his daughters were पुष्पोत्कटा and वाका; father-in-law of विश्रवस्. भा. VIII. १०. ५७; Br.
(III)--(वर्षम्) a kingdom of भद्राश्व. Br. II. १४. ५१; वा. ३३. ४४; ४३. 5.
